content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-works-how|COREMERCH guide to payment]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-stock-photos-without-paypal-what-actually-how|Selling Stock]]-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal|infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Fonts online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a complete set of tools and services that allow digital creators to build and manage their own online stores. This approach matters because it gives creators full ownership and control over their stores, eliminating the risk of platform restrictions or account suspensions. By using open-source technologies and decentralized payment systems, creators can ensure that their stores remain operational and profitable, regardless of external factors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure typically involves a combination of free and paid tools, including hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic providers like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing systems like NOWPayments. These components work together to provide a seamless and secure shopping experience for customers, while also ensuring that creators receive timely and reliable payments for their digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to conventional payment platforms is limited or restricted. This includes countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, where creators face significant challenges in selling their digital products online. By providing a reliable and secure alternative, sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers these creators to reach a global audience and monetize their skills and talents.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include hosting services, backend logic providers, payment processing systems, and digital product delivery mechanisms. These components must be carefully selected and integrated to ensure a seamless and secure shopping experience for customers. By using open-source technologies and decentralized systems, creators can minimize their reliance on external platforms and maximize their control over their online stores.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can start by selecting the necessary components and tools. This may involve setting up a hosting service, configuring backend logic, and integrating a payment processing system. By following a step-by-step approach and leveraging available resources and documentation, creators can quickly and easily establish their own online stores and start selling their digital products to a global audience.
Where can I sell my fonts online?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Own and control your online store.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Sovereign Blueprint, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for $47, provides a comprehensive guide to deploying sovereign commerce infrastructure. This resource includes complete documentation, source code, and integration guides, empowering creators to establish their own online stores and start selling their digital products with confidence.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
